meta.name: mobile-mapshot-reborn
meta.author: YourName & Mythril
meta.description:
An updated version of the original Mobile Mapshot. 
Allows mobile players to capture full map screenshots easily.

[accent]Changes in this version:[]
- Optimized for Mindustry V8 (v146+)
- Improved memory handling
- Clean UI integration

Mapshots are saved in the [sky]screenshots[] folder.
